description: Run a behavior in a session to completion and report what it produced: an action (%action then %continue), a state machine (%state, then %advance when a duration is given), a calc (%calc) or an analysis case (%analysis). Objects the run creates stay in the session, and the run's executor stays inspectable with debug_current until the next run or debug_stop. Under %engine check the behavior is checked over every schedule instead.

arguments.description: argument expressions: positional for a calc; positional, in parameter order, or written parameter=expression for an action's inputs or an analysis case

duration.description: for state: advance the machine's clock by this many time units after its initial transition; omit to take the initial transition alone

kind.description: what to run: action, state (a state machine), calc or analysis (an analysis, verification or trade-study case)

object.description: an object the session holds (name, #id or path such as car.fl): the performer of an action or state machine, the subject of a case

schedule.description: scheduling policy for this run alone: declared, reverse, seed:<n> or explore[:runs=N,depth=D]; omit for the session's

session.description: session name; omit for the default session

name: session_run

tied.description: passed over for one evaluating alike

rows.description: one per run of a sweep or of repeated runs

error.description: what stopped the run when it failed

tied.description: passed over for one evaluating alike

status.description: holds, fails or unresolved; unresolved is a question the model did not answer (an unknown name, a run that could not be made)

subject.description: what was run or checked, as named

values.description: what the run produced: a calc's result, an action's outputs, a case's outputs and verdicts
